title: Four left rectangles under y = x²

steps.say: Split [0, 2] into four strips of width 0.5. Each rectangle takes the curve's height at its left end.
The heights are f(0) = 0 (a flat rectangle, not drawn), f(0.5) = 0.25, f(1) = 1 and f(1.5) = 2.25.
Area ≈ 0.5 × (0 + 0.25 + 1 + 2.25) = 1.75. The exact area is 8/3 ≈ 2.667, so left ends underestimate here.
